description: This Java class 'KeyStoreFactory' manages SSL/TLS keystore creation, loading, and SSLContext initialization for the MockServer project, including handling certificates, trust managers, and keystore persistence.

classes.name: KeyStoreFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating, loading, and managing SSL keystores and SSLContext instances for secure communication.

methods.name: sslContext
methods.description: Returns an SSLContext, creating and configuring it if necessary, using the stored certificates and keys.

methods.name: sslContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an SSLContext initialized with provided private key, certificates, and trust managers.

methods.name: loadOrCreateKeyStore
methods.description: Loads an existing keystore from file or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: loadOrCreateKeyStore
methods.description: Loads an existing keystore or creates a new one with provided keys and certificates.

methods.name: getSSLContextInstance
methods.description: Retrieves an SSLContext instance with TLSv1.2 protocol, falling back to TLSv1 if unavailable.

methods.name: savePrivateKeyAndX509InKeyStore
methods.description: Saves private key and certificates into a keystore, then persists it to disk.
